name: Viperi-class cargo shuttle
description: The Viperi-class cargo shuttle was a type of shuttle. Dahara, a Hutt of the Devirsivik Clan, utilized a refitted Viperi-class cargo shuttle that she named the Sarlacc's Scorn. Churo the Hutt compared the shape of the shuttle to the head of a Hutta snake with landing struts that gave it a spiderlike appearance.
